goal: Produce a verified, frozen VII release candidate in which public navigation, multilingual crawl surfaces, redirects and administration presentation are internally consistent and every remaining gap is explicit.

intent_model.literal_request: Complete anything not done, verify sitemaps, files, tools and all languages, reconcile navigation and 301 redirects, apply the complete Kidum Adir standard, and raise the administration appearance to platform level.
intent_model.implied_outcome: Stop regressions and launch risk by proving the entire routing, SEO, localization and administration family together instead of repairing isolated examples.
likely_rejections: A representative sample is called complete.
Breadcrumbs look right but URLs, schema or redirects disagree.
The admin looks futuristic but does not function end to end.
Mixed-language or missing localized routes remain.
Work is described as public without an authorized verified deployment.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Inventory every affected family and classify each item.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: No unclassified route, locale, sitemap, redirect or admin module.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Distinguish visual hierarchy from actual canonical URL changes.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Redirects are required only for published path changes and must be direct to the final canonical destination.

interpretation_rules.operational_meaning: Use a coherent premium operational visual system without sacrificing clarity or function.
interpretation_rules.acceptance_impact: Admin desktop, mobile, loading, empty, error and dense-data states need visual and functional evidence.

cognitive_flow.current_layer: One clear audit result: passed, repaired or blocked by family.
cognitive_flow.current_decision: Whether the frozen candidate is ready for a separate publication approval.
cognitive_flow.next_action: If every gate passes, request explicit production publication approval; otherwise continue safe repairs or report a precise external blocker.

natural_destination: Exact frozen VII candidate in browser and its generated crawl and redirect outputs.

facts.claim: The current public target is vii.spaplus.co and prior work did not certify the complete routing, redirect and admin family together.
Production publication is not explicitly authorized by the latest request.
facts.evidence: Current user request asks to perform and verify, not to publish.

assumptions.claim: The current release worktree contains the latest intended candidate changes.
assumptions.validation: Compare branch status, recent commits and generated public evidence before using it.

assumptions.claim: The stored legacy inventory is the best available bounded source until a newer full export is discovered.
assumptions.validation: Inspect inventory provenance, counts and latest generated audit artifacts.

out_of_scope: inventing missing translations or business facts
invariants: Preserve verified public functionality and content.
Do not change URLs merely to match breadcrumb display order.
Do not redirect unrelated legacy URLs to the homepage.
Do not expose private admin data or weaken authorization.
Do not publish from a dirty or rebuilt-after-approval tree.

requirements.statement: Every public sitemap and crawl-control surface is internally consistent across all supported languages.
requirements.source: User request and Kidum Adir standard.

requirements.statement: Every affected breadcrumb follows home, world, region, city, place where those levels exist and agrees with URL and structured data.
Every published path change has one direct permanent redirect and the complete known legacy inventory has no chain, loop or homepage catch-all.
requirements.source: User request and VII master plan.

requirements.statement: All supported languages have unique crawlable routes, localized metadata and navigation without mixed-language public UI leftovers.
requirements.source: User request and accepted multilingual standard.

requirements.statement: The administration system has a coherent premium platform visual system and every supported module remains operational, authorized and persistent.
requirements.source: User request and admin product standard.

requirements.statement: The exact candidate passes build, regression, route, SEO, redirect, visual and mobile checks and production remains unchanged without explicit approval.

acceptance_checks.setup: Generated candidate and supported public origin available.
acceptance_checks.action: Crawl sitemap indexes and every child URL in HE, EN, FR and RU.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each URL has the intended 200 status, canonical, language, alternate set, robots state and sitemap membership with zero unexplained conflicts.

acceptance_checks.setup: Representative place, region, search and content routes in every world.
acceptance_checks.action: Compare visible breadcrumb, URL, H1 and BreadcrumbList.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: All existing hierarchy levels match and no duplicate or missing city level remains where verified city data exists.

acceptance_checks.action: Resolve every source without automatic redirect following and inspect the final target.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Each mapped source has one permanent hop to an equivalent final canonical target; missing mappings, gone pages and blockers are explicitly classified.

acceptance_checks.setup: Localized route family in non-Hebrew locale.
acceptance_checks.action: Scan rendered navigation, headings, cards, forms, metadata and errors for Hebrew leftovers or lost locale prefixes.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No unsupported mixed-language UI remains; verified untranslated supplier-owned names are separately classified rather than fabricated.

acceptance_checks.action: Open admin entry and representative modules.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: Unauthorized access is blocked and the authorized shell provides clear branded navigation, states and role-appropriate tools.

acceptance_checks.setup: A safe representative admin edit in a test or isolated candidate data path.
acceptance_checks.action: Save, reload without cache and inspect the natural destination.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The authoritative value persists, an audit state is visible and the intended public or operational surface reflects it without exposing unrelated permissions.

acceptance_checks.setup: Frozen candidate on desktop, 390-pixel mobile and low-height viewport.
acceptance_checks.action: Open and inspect full-page public and admin representative routes and exercise visible controls.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: No overlap, empty band, clipping, dead control, mixed-language state or broken responsive transition remains.

acceptance_checks.setup: Clean isolated candidate identity and known public baseline.
acceptance_checks.action: Run full build and regression gates without publishing.
acceptance_checks.observable_result: The candidate is reproducible, its diff is bounded, rollback identity is known and release evidence explicitly states production unchanged.

open_questions.question: Does an authorized signed-in administration session exist in the current execution context for live persistence checks?
open_questions.resolution: Inspect available authorized session; if absent, complete source and isolated tests and record live admin persistence as a precise blocker.

authorization_boundary: Local implementation and read-only public verification are authorized. Production publication, DNS, indexing, analytics/tag publication, infrastructure and external messages require separate explicit approval.
